rules.matching: CS-to-CS: overlap OR CS overlap OR representative LD; CS-to-unretained: posterior overlap only, unresolved
rules.component_layer: All active components plus formal CS boundary cases; diffuse overlap is descriptive, not a confirmed split/merge
rules.resolution: Continuous entropy effective-candidate count and fraction; no calibrated binary diffuse threshold
rules.candidates: Union of formal CS members, requested top candidates and PIP-threshold candidates
rules.display: Baseline first; greedy one-to-one formal-CS aid is not evidence of unique signal identity

limitations: PIP across settings is not averaged into a posterior.
CS count and matching relations do not identify an independent causal signal count.
Genotype correlation alone does not establish that two effects are conditionally indistinguishable.
